sentences: The prefix-U1 problem maintains a sequence over a small monoid while supporting updates and prefix-product queries.
Its queries capture whether a nonneutral element occurs within a specified prefix, relating the task to finding a minimum position.
The conjecture rules out a data structure with constant time per operation in the stated logarithmic-word RAM model.
The source emphasizes that ordinary cell-probe arguments do not establish the desired obstacle.
A lower bound would isolate computational work inside a word operation as a genuine limitation in dynamic regular-language membership.
